Container.Name: OmniRoute
Container.Overview:
OmniRoute is a free, MIT-licensed AI gateway. One OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint (/v1) routes to many providers, including free tiers such as Gemini, Groq and OpenRouter :free models, and falls back to the next healthy provider when one hits its limit. Point Claude Code or any other tool at it.
First start: open the Web UI, set the dashboard password in the onboarding wizard, add your provider keys under Providers, then create an API key for your tools. Base URL for tools: http://SERVER-IP:20128/v1
Third-party app, not made by this repository's author. Keep it on your LAN; do not forward the port to the internet.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ai gateway llm router proxy openai anthropic claude code fallback free models gemini groq openrouter

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, saved secrets, backups. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Memory heap (MB)
Config.Description: Node heap. 1024 is enough for the dashboard and light chat; one coding agent such as Claude Code needs 8192.

Config.Name: Initial dashboard password
Config.Description: Leave empty and set the password in the onboarding wizard on first visit. Ignored once a password is saved.

Config.Name: JWT secret
Config.Description: Leave empty: generated on first run and saved in the data folder.

Config.Name: API key secret
Config.Description: Leave empty: generated on first run and saved in the data folder.
